title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Patrick Reed Withdraws
items.text: Patrick Reed withdrew from the BMW PGA Championship during Friday's second round due to a wrist/hand injury caused by his club hitting a tree root on the ninth hole, impacting his Race to Dubai lead and opening an opportunity for Rory McIlroy.

items.headline: Pebble Beach Changes Noted
items.text: At this week's Pure Insurance Championship, Pebble Beach is showcasing two significant course changes that players have noticed, potentially affecting play.
